exercises.q: Tom and I talked all night.
exercises.why: **проговорили** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: We talked about it all night.
exercises.why: **проговорили** — проговори́ть (perfective): to say, to utter; to talk (for a while). Wiktionary: про- + говори́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **прожить** — прожи́ть (perfective): to live, to outlast; to reside (for some time); (transitive) to spend, to run through. Wiktionary: про- + жить.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (colloquial) to master (in detail), to study (in detail), to work through
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: походи́ть — to look like, to resemble; прорабо́тать — (colloquial) to master (in detail), to study (in detail), to work through; просиде́ть — to sit (for a while); проговори́ть — to say, to utter.

exercises.q: He won't live a long life.
exercises.why: **проживёт** — прожи́ть (perfective): to live, to outlast; to reside (for some time); (transitive) to spend, to run through. Wiktionary: про- + жить.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **пробежал** — пробежа́ть (perfective): to run past, to run through; to run a certain distance or for some time; to skim, to scan, to look through. Wiktionary: про- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **пробежал** — пробежа́ть (perfective): to run past, to run through; to run a certain distance or for some time; to skim, to scan, to look through. Wiktionary: про- + бежа́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to keep silent, to be silent (for a while)
to carry (for a while; on foot)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: прожи́ть — to live, to outlast; помолча́ть — to keep silent, to be silent (for a while); приподня́ть — to raise, to lift (a little); понести́ — to carry (for a while; on foot).
**поделать** — поде́лать (perfective): to make, to do (for a while). Wiktionary: по- + де́лать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I'm going to do something else.
exercises.why: **поделаю** — поде́лать (perfective): to make, to do (for a while). Wiktionary: по- + де́лать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: He stood an entire hour by the window.
exercises.why: **простоял** — простоя́ть (perfective): to stand, to stay (for some time); to stand idle; to stand, to remain (of buildings). Wiktionary: про- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to run past, to run through
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: почита́ть — to read (for a while); пробежа́ть — to run past, to run through; посиде́ть — to sit (for a while); послужи́ть — to serve (for some time).
